description: This file defines the `DefaultStreamingConfig` class implementing the `StreamingConfig` interface. It manages configuration settings related to streaming, such as session interval, acknowledgment, web socket, and server-sent events, and provides methods to load these configurations from an external `Config` source.

classes.name: DefaultStreamingConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing the StreamingConfig interface, encapsulating streaming-related configuration properties and providing static factory method for instantiation from external Config.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStreamingConfig from a Config object, applying fallback configurations.

methods.name: getSessionCounterScrapeInterval
methods.description: Returns the session counter scrape interval duration.

methods.name: getSearchIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the search idle timeout duration.
